crossRefs.note: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!

translations.web: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
translations.bsb: Do not be one who gives pledges, who puts up security for debts.
translations.kjv: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
translations.asv: Be thou not one of them that strike hands, Or of them that are sureties for debts.
